blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— The long arms of the law finally caught up with a 46-year-old fugitive after he was arrested in Bislig City, Surigao del Sur, on Tuesday, ending 15 years of hiding. Operatives of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG)-Surigao del Sur collared the suspect, listed as the city’s Top 2 most wanted at the municipal level, around 9 a.m. in Barangay Poblacion. Police said the suspect, an unemployed resident of Barangay 6 – Diego Silang in Butuan City, was arrested by virtue of a warrant issued by Regional Trial Court Branch 29 in Bislig City on […]...
